questions: Have you noticed a tremor or shaking in your hands when they are at rest?
Have your movements become noticeably slower?
Have you experienced stiffness in your arms, legs, neck, or shoulders?
Have you had difficulty walking or maintaining your balance?
Has your handwriting become smaller or more difficult to read?
Have you noticed a reduced sense of smell?
Have you had constipation or acting out your dreams during sleep?
Have you experienced involuntary jerking, twisting, or writhing movements?
Have you had weakness or numbness on one side of your body?
Have you had any recent change in speech, swallowing, or facial expression?
Have you experienced memory problems or changes in thinking?
Have you ever had a stroke or other neurologic illness?
Are you currently taking medication for Parkinson’s disease or another movement disorder?
